highlights.title: Review a bot's work in the Inbox
highlights.text: Inbox › New has a To review group with a verdict, what was checked and what couldn't be. Approve, Send back or Roll back, and approve low-risk passes together.

highlights.title: A second check before you approve
highlights.text: A teammate on another model runs a task's checks again in a clean copy of the files. It says Pass only when kwant ran a check itself, and lists what it couldn't check.

highlights.title: Point at the part of the page you mean
highlights.text: In Watch live, press Point and click part of the page. The bot gets its address, HTML, size and styles, and a picture of it. Point only reads the page.

highlights.title: Notes on diff lines, sent as one message
highlights.text: Add notes on lines of a Dev desk review card and send them together. CI failures and review comments on a bot's PR go back to that bot too.

highlights.title: A worktree for each bot task
highlights.text: The Dev desk's Worktrees tab makes a worktree from a branch, for a bot or for you. Remove never deletes the branch. Build folders are cleaned an hour after a task.

highlights.title: Watch a mission
highlights.text: Pick a bot to check a mission's claims when it stops. A claim that doesn't hold sends its task back, and the report shows what was claimed and what was checked.

fixes: One order everywhere: needs you, stuck or failed, to review, finished, working, waiting. Needs attention sits above Channels.
Roll back works after approval too: the approved record stays, a copy waits on hold, and the bot drops one Flight School tier.
Bots leave notes about their tools. Read and fix them under Notes from bots in Settings › Connections.
A message to a busy or stuck bot is kept, and a line under it says why it waits. Try again when the bot gave up.
One notification when a bot's turn shows no step for 15 minutes.
A bot's other chats wait while it waits on your answer to its question.
A monthly budget per bot, set through the API for now. At 100% the bot finishes its turn and starts nothing new.
Changing a bot's model starts its Flight School scorecard again.
A retried API send with the same client_message_id arrives once.
